source='''def transform(grid):
    holes = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    top = min(r for r, _ in holes)
    bottom = max(r for r, _ in holes)
    left = min(c for _, c in holes)
    right = max(c for _, c in holes)
    width = len(grid[0])
    return [[grid[r][width - 1 - c] if grid[r][c] == 0 else grid[r][c]
             for c in range(left, right + 1)]
            for r in range(top, bottom + 1)]
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
